findings.issue: en mistranslates the sentence: わけにはいかない expresses 'cannot afford to / must not (for moral-social reasons)', not emotional intolerance ('can't stand'), and 負け犬になる is 'become a loser', not 'getting beaten'. It contradicts lit_en, pt, and both expl fields, misteaching the target pattern.
findings.suggested: I can't let myself become a loser.

findings.issue: Tokens 0-3 (高校, 生, 大学, 生, all-null glosses/roles) are stray fragments prepended before 彼女; the concatenated token surfaces no longer reconstruct the sentence and duplicate parts of the later tokens 高校生/大学生. They look like leftover furigana sub-tokens.
findings.current: tokens begin: 高校, 生, 大学, 生, then 彼女, は, 高校生…
findings.suggested: Delete tokens 0-3 so the token list starts at 彼女 and matches the sentence surface.

findings.issue: lit_pt renders カーテンから as 'Cortina de luz', which a reader parses as genitive 'curtain of light', misrepresenting から (origin, 'from'). lit_en correctly has 'Light leaks from the curtain'. The mirror teaches the wrong particle relation.
風見 means (roof-mounted) weather vane/weathercock; a windsock is 吹き流し. 'windsock' is not a valid gloss for 風見 (JMdict: weather vane). The pt gloss correctly has only 'cata-vento'.
ひとりでに means 'by itself / automatically / spontaneously'; 'alone' is a gloss of ひとりで and does not fit this adverb in any context, including this one (the door opened by itself).
